configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Shared settings. binaryDir is always <source>/build: COSMIC_SDK_DIR is the SOURCE dir and every target writes to ${COSMIC_SDK_DIR}/build/Runtime/$<CONFIG>, so a second binary dir in the same source tree would clobber the first one's Cosmic.dll. Use a git worktree for the other configuration, not a second build folder.

configurePresets.name: 2d
configurePresets.description: The only configuration on this trunk: the 2D engine (Jolt stays). The 3D source, its vendored dependencies and the 3D preset were purged (AP-05); COSMIC_2D_ONLY=ON is kept as an explicit, always-on compatibility flag.
